 CRL.MC NO. 614 OF 2018 2  2024:KER:70092  P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, J  --------------------------------------

 Dated this the 13th day of September, 2024  ORDER
This Criminal Miscellaneous case is filed to quash the FIR in Crime No. 378/2016 of Panoor Police Station.

The above case is registered alleging offences punishable under Sec. 498A r/w 34 IPC.
2.
When this Criminal Miscellaneous case came up for consideration, the learned counsel for the petitioner and the counsel appearing for the 2nd respondent submitted that the matter is settled.
The Public Prosecutor also submitted that the matter is settled and statement is obtained from the victim.
If that is the case, I think this Criminal Miscellaneous case can be allowed because, it is a matrimonial dispute and the continuation of the prosecution is not necessary.
Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous case is allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No. 378/2016 of Panoor Police Station are quashed.
